versions.changelog:
- Initial release of Huawei Cloud Ascend Profiler DB Explorer.
- Converts natural language questions into safe, executable SQL for Ascend PyTorch Profiler and msprof databases.
- Supports performance analysis on operator time, communication, and dispatch bottlenecks.
- Provides profiling table schema extraction from official documentation.
- Ensures secure SQL construction using strict macro and CTE templates; discourages ad-hoc queries.
